title: Comfort Club Cancellation Credit Worksheet
content:
Settlement worksheet for the cancellation credit on an annually billed agreement under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements. The credit is worked out in this order.

1. **Term dues billed.** The annual, renewal, additional-system and upgrade proration dues charges of the current term — being those posted fewer whole calendar months before the date of handling than the whole calendar months elapsed since the term began, plus one.
2. **Refundable dues.** The term dues billed multiplied by the unused full months and divided by twelve, rounded to the cent half up. The unused full months are the whole calendar months counted as complete month-to-month steps from the date of handling that end on or before the term end.
3. **Visit chargeback.** The completed cooling and heating tune-ups charged to the current term times the tier's tune-up retail value, plus the completed whole-home visits charged to the current term times the tier's whole-home visit retail value; that sum multiplied by the visit chargeback rate and rounded to the cent half up. The visit chargeback rate is one (1.0).
4. **Coverage chargeback.** The covered-repair benefit drawn in the current term multiplied by the coverage chargeback rate, rounded to the cent half up. The coverage chargeback rate is one (1.0).
5. **Install credit recapture.** The member installation credit posted on the member's Harbison installation contracts within the 12 months before the date of handling, multiplied by the install credit recapture rate and rounded to the cent half up. The install credit recapture rate is zero.
6. **Discount recapture.** The member repair discounts posted on the member's service calls within that same current-term window, multiplied by the discount recapture rate and rounded to the cent half up. The discount recapture rate is zero.
7. **Cancellation credit.** The refundable dues less the visit chargeback, the coverage chargeback, the install credit recapture and the discount recapture, rounded to the cent half up, and never below zero.

## Worked example (hypothetical Comfort Club Gold agreement, one system)
Term 1 March 2025 to 28 February 2026; renewal dues 249.00 posted 1 March 2025; one cooling tune-up completed in the term; no covered-repair benefit drawn; date of handling 20 August 2025.

| Line | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Whole months elapsed since the term began | 1 March to 20 August | 5 |
| Term dues billed | renewal dues posted 5 whole months back, fewer than 6 | 249.00 |
| Unused full months | steps ending 20 September through 20 February fall on or before 28 February; 20 March does not | 6 |
| Refundable dues | 249.00 multiplied by 6, divided by twelve | 124.50 |
| Visit chargeback | 1 tune-up at 109.00, multiplied by one | 109.00 |
| Coverage chargeback | nothing drawn | 0.00 |
| Install credit and discount recapture | rate of zero | 0.00 |
| Cancellation credit | 124.50 less 109.00 | 15.50 |

Had a second tune-up also been completed in the term, the visit chargeback of 218.00 would exceed the refundable dues of 124.50 and the credit would be 0.00.
